proposal.quote: no obligation exists for it to assume the foreign debts of the former Austrian Federal Government
proposal.rule: claude backend: Annexed rule: the German Government refers to the 'former Austrian Federal Government' and negotiates Austria's debts as its own successor, which implies the reunification is in force, though the note does not mention German troops.

proposal.quote: more and more an enthusiastic supporter of the Rome–Berlin Axis
proposal.rule: claude backend: The axis rule sets the flag on the Rome-Berlin alignment; the ambassador refers to the Rome–Berlin Axis as an existing alignment that Franco supports.

proposal.quote: the preoccupation of Japan in China
proposal.rule: claude backend: china_war is true when Japan's army is engaged in a general war in China; a congressman's remark on Japan's 'preoccupation' in China only hints at this, without stating the war outright.

proposal.quote: the preoccupation of Japan in China caused him to believe that now would be an admirable time to enact legislation
proposal.rule: claude backend: The china_war rule requires Japan's army to be engaged in a general war in China; a congressman's passing reference to Japan's 'preoccupation' in China suggests a major ongoing commitment there but does not state outright that a general war is under way.

proposal.quote: affected by the absorption of Austria into the German Reich
proposal.rule: claude backend: The annexed level requires Austria incorporated into the Reich; the US note treats Austria's absorption into the German Reich as an accomplished fact and refers to the 'former Austrian Federal Government'.

proposal.quote: Hitler, encouraged by Ribbentrop, Himmler and others, is considering an attack on the Western powers as a preliminary to subsequent action in the east... His Majesty’s Government have carefully considered the situation in the light of these reports and have decided to accelerate as far as possible the preparation of their defensive and counter-offensive measures
proposal.rule: claude backend: The message, approved by the Prime Minister and Cabinet advisers as the Government's view, treats German aims as possibly beyond revision and adopts contingency measures while still seeking to deter, which is the uncertain level (the war scares of Jan–Feb 1939).

proposal.quote: have decided to accelerate as far as possible the preparation of their defensive and counter-offensive measures
proposal.rule: claude backend: The government prepares for a possible military answer to a further German move (accelerated preparations, arbitration plan giving locus standi for action over Holland), but this is a confidential communication rather than a public acceptance, so the wary threshold is only partly met.

proposal.quote: the atmosphere both at Paris and here is charged with grave uncertainty... Both the British and the French are extremely anxious that our Government put our private producers in a position “to sell” (as the French put it) war materials to them in case of need.
proposal.rule: claude backend: The uncertain level covers the war scares of Jan to Feb 1939, when London and Paris treated German aims as possibly beyond revision and sought contingency measures (access to American war materials) while still pursuing peace; the evidence is an American envoy's report, not Cabinet records.

proposal.quote: since the breaking out of the conflict with China
proposal.rule: claude backend: china_war is true when Japan is engaged in a general war in China, and a Japanese official refers to the conflict with China as having broken out and still continuing.

proposal.quote: will raise the embargo on arms which weighs on the Government of the Spanish Republic
proposal.rule: claude backend: The isolationist level covers the Neutrality Act regime with a mandatory arms embargo, and the passage shows a US arms embargo still in force, here against Spain, which Spain asks to have lifted.

proposal.quote: recent elaborate note of January 24, 1939 “received from his Government, in which many of the rumors and reports as to circumstances and conditions of a nature calculated to be the forerunner of a possible military outbreak in Europe were set forth
proposal.rule: claude backend: belief_WEST uncertain covers the war scares of Jan to Feb 1939; here the British Government formally warns Washington of a possible military outbreak in Europe, so it treats German aims as possibly beyond revision, though the document reports only the note and not Cabinet records.

proposal.quote: Bonnet said that he believed Germany did not desire war this spring. There was every indication that Hitler wished to employ the coming months to get Hungary and Rumania completely under his control.
proposal.rule: claude backend: The French Foreign Minister treats German aims as reaching beyond ethnic revision, to full control of Hungary and Romania, while still expecting no deliberate war; this fits 'uncertain' rather than 'limited' or 'hegemonic'.

proposal.quote: in the face of what might be a very grave situation his Government was necessarily constrained to take account of and examine every possibility
proposal.rule: claude backend: Under the 'uncertain' rule, the Foreign Secretary, speaking for his government during the Jan 1939 war scares, treats German intentions as possibly grave and has the reports examined as contingencies, while not accepting them as established.

proposal.quote: There are approximately six hundred thousand Jews remaining in Germany, including Austria and the Sudetenland, at the present time.
proposal.rule: claude backend: The annexed level requires Austria to be under German control; the memorandum counts Austria as part of Germany, which implies annexation but does not state the troops or the reunification law.

proposal.quote: There are approximately six hundred thousand Jews remaining in Germany, including Austria and the Sudetenland, at the present time.
proposal.rule: claude backend: The german level requires the ceded Sudeten areas to be under German control; the memorandum counts the Sudetenland as part of Germany, which implies cession but does not state it directly.

proposal.quote: leave criticism of Italian words and acts to the British and Americans who were not at the moment objects of Mussolini’s immediate hostility
proposal.rule: claude backend: Italy estranged from the West: the French Foreign Minister describes Mussolini's open hostility toward France and Italian press demands for French territory, which is consistent with the estranged level, though this is the French government's reading of Italian intent.

proposal.quote: to ask the Japanese to promise to get out of Hainan when the war with China should come to an end
proposal.rule: claude backend: The French Prime Minister refers to an ongoing war between Japan and China, which meets the rule's condition of Japan engaged in a general war in China.

proposal.quote: war would be imminent if it were not for the hesitation created in Germany and Italy by the evolution of opinion in the United States
